resolved_findings.reason: The complete source inventory is hash-bound by the contract and compared with the current source before copy. It covers source bytes and modes, Git metadata, and all admitted bootstrap outputs. The actual new assertion rejected all six focused drift cases before any destination copy began.
resolved_findings.initial_candidate_and_review_retention: Verified all 3 initial candidate copies and 12 initial-review copies against exact original hashes and private reviewer originals.

source_derivation.method: Executed only the hash-bound pure prefix_inventory function against the real source; matched all bytes/modes/kinds. Calculated Git blob SHA1 values from actual file bytes, reconstructed every Git tree from the retained NUL-delimited ls-tree entries using Git ordering and raw tree encodings, and matched the pinned root tree hash. No Git command was run against the source.
